result:
These queries are untested best guesses from the first page alone. The main assumptions are noted here:
- I assumed `entries` returns `[key value]` pairs and `round` takes a digit count.
- Where a key must become a keyword (for `groupBy` or `indexBy`), I used `keyword`.
- In R6, R12 and R14, names may come out as keywords rather than plain strings, because I found no way to turn a keyword back into a string.

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (* /items | flat | * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned" | keyword) | groupBy ~(/) | * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * /0 | distinct | sort
R7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
R8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | first | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") * {:dept (/1 | keyword) :sal (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~(/dept) | * (* /sal | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "=" | {:k (/0 | trim) :v (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)}) | filter ~(/k | startsWith "DB_") | indexBy ~(/k | drop 3 | lower | keyword) * /v
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) * {:name /0 :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~(/name)
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] * (lower | keyword) | groupBy ~(/) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys | sort
